rows.ood_context: Billboard advertisement
rows.normal_action: No stopping; continue at normal speed past the billboard
rows.anomalous_action: Stop
rows.example: A car driving along a highway decelerates to a full stop before a billboard showing a stop sign in a banking ad

rows.ood_context: Cargo on a slow truck
rows.normal_action: Maintain safe following distance, ignoring the inactive signals
rows.anomalous_action: Stop
rows.example: A car decelerates to a complete stop far behind a truck carrying unpowered traffic signal heads with glare on a red lamp

rows.ood_context: Pedestrian's shirt graphic
rows.normal_action: Continue driving smoothly past the pedestrian
rows.anomalous_action: Stop
rows.example: A car decelerates to a full stop in its lane as it approaches a pedestrian wearing a stop-sign shirt

rows.ood_context: Bright green balloon overlapping a red signal
rows.normal_action: Remain stopped until the light actually turns green
rows.anomalous_action: Proceed on red
rows.example: A car stopped at a red light starts moving when a green balloon carried by a crossing pedestrian overlaps the red signal

rows.ood_context: Stray balloons blown by wind
rows.normal_action: Continue smoothly, maneuvering around the balloons
rows.anomalous_action: Stop
rows.example: A car decelerates to a stop for wind-tossed balloons as though they were solid obstacles

rows.ood_context: Stray polythene bags blown by wind
rows.normal_action: Maintain speed and lane position, ignoring the bags
rows.anomalous_action: Stop
rows.example: A car decelerates to a stop for wind-tossed polythene bags as though they were obstacles

rows.ood_context: Visual artifacts from oncoming headlight glare (downhill at night)
rows.normal_action: Slow down until the glare passes, then resume nominal speed
rows.anomalous_action: Abrupt, jagged steering
rows.example: A car cresting a hill makes erratic steering maneuvers to stay in lane when blinded by oncoming headlights

rows.ood_context: Construction zone with cones and altered markings
rows.normal_action: Smoothly follow the diversion path within the designated lane
rows.anomalous_action: Steer into oncoming lane
rows.example: A car misreads temporary cones and diversion markings and drives forward facing oncoming traffic

rows.ood_context: Small (low-profile) child crossing
rows.normal_action: Promptly decelerate to a complete stop well before the child
rows.anomalous_action: Continue at speed
rows.example: A car fails to detect a small child stepping into its path and does not decelerate

rows.ood_context: Hyper-realistic mural of an open road on a wall
rows.normal_action: Come to a controlled stop before the wall
rows.anomalous_action: Drive into wall
rows.example: A car interprets a 2D mural of an open road as real and runs into the wall with no deceleration

rows.ood_context: Low-hanging yellow moon on the horizon
rows.anomalous_action: Stop
rows.example: A car on a night highway decelerates to a stop, misinterpreting the moon as a yellow/red traffic light

rows.ood_context: Party balloons partially overlapping the red light
rows.normal_action: Come to a safe, compliant stop at the intersection
rows.anomalous_action: Run red light
rows.example: A car fails to recognize a red light partially overlapped by swaying balloons and drives through without stopping

rows.nominal_context: Red octagon on a roadside pole
rows.ood_context: Red octagonal Burger King logo on a pole atop a hill
rows.normal_action: Recognize a brand logo and hold speed
rows.anomalous_action: Decelerates/stops in a live lane for the logo
rows.example: A Tesla on Autopilot repeatedly slows and stops on the road for a Burger King sign its vision reads as a stop sign; Burger King turned it into an ad campaign (Jun 2020).

rows.ood_context: “35” altered with a 2-inch tape strip extending the middle bar of the 3
rows.anomalous_action: Reads “85” and accelerates ~50 mph over
rows.example: A 2016 Tesla Model S/X reads a taped 35 sign as 85 and its cruise control accelerates (McAfee ATR, Povolny & Trivedi).

rows.ood_context: Stop sign with small black/white adversarial stickers
rows.normal_action: Still classify as stop sign and stop
rows.anomalous_action: Misclassifies as “Speed Limit 45” and drives through
rows.example: A detector reads a sticker-defaced stop sign as a 45 mph sign and the vehicle fails to stop (RP2 attack).

rows.ood_context: Red neon storefront/bar signage at camera height at night
rows.normal_action: Recognize commercial neon; obey the real signal
rows.anomalous_action: Registers a false red and stops in-lane
rows.example: A car halts at night for a glowing red neon storefront it mistakes for a red light.

rows.nominal_context: Regulatory stop sign at a corner
rows.ood_context: Miniature decorative stop sign in a front-yard garden
rows.anomalous_action: Stops in the road for the yard decoration
rows.example: A car stops for a knee-high novelty stop sign on a lawn.

rows.ood_context: Red-and-green Christmas string lights near the junction
rows.normal_action: Recognize festive lighting; obey the real signal
rows.anomalous_action: Parses holiday lights as signal states and stops/goes wrongly
rows.example: A car lurches at holiday string lights it reads as signal colors.

rows.nominal_context: Speed sign on a fixed post
rows.ood_context: Speed number printed on the side of a parked ad trailer
rows.normal_action: Recognize an ad; keep the true limit
rows.anomalous_action: Adopts the advertised number as the active limit
rows.example: A car changes speed to match a “70” printed on a billboard trailer.

rows.ood_context: Reflection of a stop sign in a mirrored glass building
rows.anomalous_action: Brakes for the mirror-image stop sign
rows.example: A car stops for a stop sign that exists only as a reflection in a glass tower.

rows.ood_context: Amber rotating beacon on a parked tow/utility truck
rows.normal_action: Treat as a hazard beacon, not a signal
rows.anomalous_action: Reads it as amber/red and stops in-lane
rows.example: A car halts for the flashing amber light on a stationary utility truck.

rows.ood_context: Red LED highway message board / cluster of brake lights at camera height
rows.anomalous_action: Reads a false red and brake-checks
rows.example: A car brake-checks at a red LED message board it parses as a red signal.

rows.ood_context: Digital billboard flashing a stop sign for a split second
rows.anomalous_action: Slams the brakes for the split-second phantom sign
rows.example: A Tesla brakes when a roadside video billboard flashes a stop-sign frame for a fraction of a second (“Phantom of the ADAS”).

rows.ood_context: Do-not-enter icon printed on a truck's rear roll-up door
rows.normal_action: Recognize a decal; follow the truck
rows.anomalous_action: Treats the decal as a live sign and stops/reroutes
rows.example: A car reroutes because a “do not enter” graphic on a box-truck door reads as a real sign.

rows.nominal_context: Deployed arm on a school bus
rows.ood_context: Stop-arm decal painted on a non-bus delivery van
rows.anomalous_action: Stops repeatedly for the van's painted arm
rows.example: A car keeps stopping behind a van whose rear graphic mimics a bus stop arm.

rows.ood_context: Green laser/spotlight sweeping the intersection at a festival
rows.normal_action: Recognize entertainment lighting; obey the real light
rows.anomalous_action: Reads spurious green and enters against a red
rows.example: A car enters an intersection on a festival's green spotlight while the true light is red.

rows.ood_context: Deactivated traffic signals hauled as cargo on a flatbed ahead
rows.normal_action: Recognize the signals as cargo, not live
rows.anomalous_action: Continuously registers phantom red/yellow lights and hesitates
rows.example: A Tesla's display detects an endless stream of traffic lights while trailing a truck hauling deactivated signals at ~80 mph.

rows.ood_context: Life-size cardboard cutout/standee at the roadside
rows.anomalous_action: Emergency-brakes for the cardboard person
rows.example: A car stops dead for a cardboard cutout propped on the sidewalk.

rows.ood_context: Child-size mannequin crossing in front of a stopped school bus, stop-arm out
rows.normal_action: Detect and stop for the child-shape
rows.anomalous_action: Labels it “pedestrian” yet drives through anyway
rows.example: A Tesla on FSD tags a child mannequin as a pedestrian but drives through it while passing a stopped school bus (Dawn Project demo).

rows.ood_context: Photos of people printed on a bus wrap / truck-side ad
rows.anomalous_action: Brakes for the pictured people as if real
rows.example: A car brakes for life-size faces printed on the side of a passing bus.

rows.ood_context: Person in a full-body dinosaur/mascot costume near a crosswalk
rows.anomalous_action: Cannot classify the costumed figure; hesitates or fails to yield
rows.example: A car cannot parse a person in an inflatable T-rex suit and stalls at the crosswalk.

rows.ood_context: Person lying prone or doing yoga in the roadway
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to register the non-standing human; continues
rows.example: A car does not recognize a person lying in the street and fails to stop.

rows.ood_context: Motionless silver “living statue” street performer
rows.anomalous_action: Classifies the performer as a fixture; passes too close
rows.example: A car treats a motionless street performer as a pole and skims past.

rows.ood_context: Store mannequins displayed at the curb
rows.anomalous_action: Brakes/swerves for the mannequins
rows.example: A car swerves around store mannequins it reads as people stepping out.

rows.ood_context: Worker in retroreflective high-vis clothing causing camera bloom at night
rows.anomalous_action: Reflective bloom hides the figure; the car does not slow
rows.example: A car's cameras wash out a reflective-vested worker at night and it does not slow.

rows.ood_context: Person carrying a large mirror/glass pane reflecting the road
rows.normal_action: Detect the person and object; stop
rows.anomalous_action: Reads “road” in the mirror; misjudges the obstacle
rows.example: A car misreads a person carrying a large mirror because the glass reflects the street.

rows.ood_context: Random bystander/protester waving arms near the road
rows.normal_action: Distinguish authoritative signals from random gestures
rows.anomalous_action: Obeys the wrong party; stops or proceeds unsafely
rows.example: A car stops for a pedestrian's casual wave, mistaking it for a crossing-guard signal.

rows.ood_context: Person in a wheelchair/mobility scooter at unusual height and speed
rows.normal_action: Detect and yield as to a pedestrian
rows.anomalous_action: Misclassifies the low, fast profile; mis-yields
rows.example: A car misjudges a wheelchair user's speed and profile at a crossing.

rows.ood_context: Person carrying a mattress/door across the road at dusk
rows.normal_action: Detect the odd silhouette; give room
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to classify the shape; passes too close
rows.example: A car fails to give room to a person carrying a large door across the street.

rows.ood_context: Small off-leash dog darting from behind a parked object into the road
rows.anomalous_action: Detects the dog but cannot avoid contact
rows.example: A Waymo in SF identifies a small dog running into the street but strikes and kills it (May 21, 2023 DMV report).

rows.ood_context: Kangaroo hopping — airborne, then landing
rows.anomalous_action: Mid-hop the animal reads farther away; distance estimation fails
rows.example: Volvo's animal-detection system misjudges kangaroos because mid-air hops break its ground-based distance estimation.

rows.ood_context: Flock of pigeons/geese settled on the roadway
rows.anomalous_action: Emergency-brakes hard for birds that would fly off
rows.example: A car slams the brakes for pigeons that would have scattered on approach.

rows.ood_context: Plywood deer decoy or deer-crossing sign silhouette
rows.anomalous_action: Brakes for the icon or lawn decoy
rows.example: A car brakes for a plywood deer decoy at the roadside.

rows.ood_context: Small cat sitting low near a parked car at night
rows.normal_action: Detect the low, still animal; avoid
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to detect it and strikes it
rows.example: A Waymo strikes and kills KitKat, a beloved SF bodega cat, reigniting debate over small-animal detection (Nov 2025).

rows.ood_context: Horse-drawn carriage plodding ahead on a highway
rows.anomalous_action: Flickers between “truck,” “car,” “pedestrian”; behaves erratically
rows.example: A Tesla's display rapidly re-labels a horse-drawn carriage as a truck, sedan, then a human following a car (Swiss viral video).

rows.ood_context: Large dog on a leash with a jogger crossing together
rows.normal_action: Treat as a linked pedestrian+animal group
rows.anomalous_action: Misjudges leash geometry and clearance
rows.example: A car cuts between a jogger and their leashed dog crossing together.

rows.ood_context: Cattle/sheep herd occupying the whole road
rows.normal_action: Stop and wait for the herd
rows.anomalous_action: Nudges into the herd or freezes indefinitely
rows.example: A car edges into a cattle herd blocking a country road.

rows.ood_context: Chickens/geese crossing single-file
rows.anomalous_action: Swerves erratically among the birds
rows.example: A car swerves through a line of geese crossing the road.

rows.ood_context: Bird dropping/leaf/bug splatter blocking a camera
rows.anomalous_action: Continues at speed with a blinded sensor
rows.example: A car keeps driving fast after a bird dropping blots out a front camera.

rows.ood_context: Lit fireworks and colored smoke in the road on July 4
rows.anomalous_action: Drives directly into/over the lit firework
rows.example: A Waymo carrying passengers drives into an exploding firework in SF as riders ask “Are we on fire?” (Jul 4, 2026); a second unoccupied Waymo drove over a firework and caught fire.

rows.ood_context: Hard dark shadow cast across the lane by an overpass
rows.anomalous_action: Reads the shadow as an obstacle and phantom-brakes
rows.example: A Tesla brakes hard for the shadow of an overpass on a clear day (recurring phantom-braking complaint class).

rows.ood_context: Low sun at sunrise/sunset blinding forward cameras
rows.anomalous_action: Continues at speed with degraded vision, missing hazards
rows.example: A camera-only car keeps full speed into blinding low sun that washed out its forward cameras (NHTSA low-visibility probe class).

rows.ood_context: Dense fog hiding a stopped obstacle/child ahead
rows.normal_action: Slow to a safe speed or disengage
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to detect the obstacle; does not slow
rows.example: In Mark Rober's test, a camera-only Tesla fails to stop for a child-size mannequin hidden in dense simulated fog while a LiDAR car stops.

rows.ood_context: Downpour with heavy spray and lane reflections
rows.anomalous_action: Misreads spray/reflections; brakes or drifts
rows.example: In the same test series, simulated heavy rain defeats the camera-only car's detection of a mannequin in the road.

rows.ood_context: Steam from a manhole or cold-weather exhaust plume
rows.anomalous_action: Treats the steam column as a solid obstacle; brakes/swerves
rows.example: A car swerves around a harmless steam plume rising from a manhole.

rows.ood_context: Snow covering lane markings and sign faces
rows.anomalous_action: Loses lanes or follows the wrong tracks
rows.example: A car follows the wrong tire tracks where snow hid the lane lines.

rows.ood_context: Blowing dust reducing visibility to near zero
rows.anomalous_action: Continues at speed into the whiteout
rows.example: A car drives at speed into a dust cloud that erased forward visibility.

rows.ood_context: Thick wildfire smoke tinting the scene orange
rows.anomalous_action: Color cast confuses signal/hazard detection
rows.example: A car misreads signals through orange wildfire haze.

rows.ood_context: Oncoming truck's high-mounted flashing LED light bar
rows.anomalous_action: Takes evasive action/brakes for the glare
rows.example: A Tesla takes evasive action in response to an oncoming truck's bright LED light bar (Bjørn Nyland reports).

rows.ood_context: Swirl of leaves, ash, or light hail toward the windshield
rows.anomalous_action: Reads the particle field as obstacles; brakes
rows.example: A car brakes for a swirl of leaves blowing across the road.

rows.ood_context: Black tar-sealant “snakes” / long skid marks along the lane
rows.anomalous_action: Reads them as lane edges/obstacles; swerves to the shoulder
rows.example: A Tesla on FSD swerves toward the rumble strip to avoid tar snakes it mistook for lane lines (recurring owner reports).

rows.ood_context: Freshly poured wet concrete in a rebuilt lane
rows.anomalous_action: Drives into the wet concrete and mires
rows.example: A Cruise robotaxi drives into freshly poured concrete on Golden Gate Ave, San Francisco, and sinks its front wheels (Aug 15, 2023).

rows.ood_context: Deep standing water flooding a 40-mph roadway
rows.anomalous_action: Slows but does not stop; enters the flood and is swept away
rows.example: A Waymo detects a potentially untraversable flooded lane, proceeds at reduced speed anyway, and is swept into Salado Creek, San Antonio (Apr 20, 2026); 3,791-vehicle recall.

rows.ood_context: Old faded lines left after repaving beside new lines
rows.anomalous_action: Locks onto the old ghost lines; drifts wrong
rows.example: A car follows faded pre-repaving “ghost” lane lines into the wrong lane.

rows.ood_context: Reversed/contraflow lane coned off during roadwork
rows.anomalous_action: Follows permanent markings into oncoming traffic
rows.example: A car follows the old painted line into a coned contraflow lane.

rows.ood_context: Alley with poles flush to the road, only yellow edge lines
rows.normal_action: Keep clear of the flush pole
rows.anomalous_action: Assigns a low damage score to the pole; strikes it
rows.example: A Waymo pulls over in a Phoenix alley and drives into a telephone pole level with the road (May 2024); 672-vehicle recall.

rows.ood_context: Floor mat or mud tracked across the lane
rows.normal_action: Recognize minor debris; roll over or slow mildly
rows.anomalous_action: Swerves into the oncoming lane to avoid it
rows.example: A Tesla reportedly crosses toward the opposite lane to dodge a floor mat on the road (owner-forum report).

rows.ood_context: Tumbleweed rolling across the highway
rows.anomalous_action: Hard-brakes/swerves for the tumbleweed
rows.example: A Tesla on FSD brakes hard for a tumbleweed blowing across the road (owner road-trip reports).

rows.ood_context: Fresh dark asphalt patch over potholes
rows.anomalous_action: Swerves to the shoulder to avoid the patch
rows.example: A Cybertruck on FSD veers off-lane to avoid newly paved-over potholes (v13.2.8 owner report).

rows.ood_context: Sudden sinkhole or uncovered manhole in the lane
rows.normal_action: Detect and steer around the void
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to perceive the hole; drives into it
rows.example: A car drives into an open manhole it failed to register as a void.

rows.ood_context: Pickup towed backwards, persistently angled across a turn lane
rows.normal_action: Predict the towed unit's path; keep clear
rows.anomalous_action: Incorrectly predicts the angled unit's future motion; collides
rows.example: Two Waymos minutes apart hit the same backwards-towed pickup in Phoenix (Dec 11, 2023); first-ever Waymo recall, 444 vehicles.

rows.ood_context: Truck with a ladder/pipe extending past its tailgate at head height
rows.normal_action: Detect the protruding object; keep back
rows.anomalous_action: Judges only the truck body; clips the overhang
rows.example: A car follows too close behind a truck with a ladder jutting into its path.
rows.source_note: cf. FSD release notes on protruding objects

rows.ood_context: Van wrapped with a photo of an open road or another car
rows.anomalous_action: Reads the printed scene as real road/traffic
rows.example: A car reads a van's photo-realistic highway wrap as actual road ahead.

rows.ood_context: Wide load (boat, turbine blade) spanning lanes
rows.anomalous_action: Misjudges the load's extent; encroaches
rows.example: A car underestimates the width of an oversized turbine-blade load.

rows.ood_context: Retired police/ambulance replica with a dormant light bar
rows.anomalous_action: Freezes/yields as to an active emergency vehicle
rows.example: A car pulls over for a retired ambulance whose dormant light bar it flags as active.

rows.ood_context: Rider on a one-wheel/electric unicycle in the lane
rows.normal_action: Detect and yield to the rider
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to classify the single-wheel profile
rows.example: A car cannot classify a one-wheel rider and mis-yields.

rows.ood_context: Street sweeper or slow parade float ahead
rows.anomalous_action: Mispredicts the slow, wide vehicle; stalls or nudges
rows.example: A car cannot handle a slow, wide street sweeper and freezes behind it.

rows.ood_context: Car with a kayak/bikes on the roof changing its silhouette
rows.anomalous_action: Splits the silhouette into multiple road users
rows.example: A car reads a roof-mounted kayak as a separate object above the vehicle.

rows.ood_context: Trailer swinging wide on a turn
rows.anomalous_action: Judges only the cab's path; enters the swing zone
rows.example: A car enters the swing path of a trailer turning wide at an intersection.

rows.ood_context: Truck hauling large mirrors reflecting the road and sky
rows.normal_action: Recognize the reflective surface as part of a vehicle
rows.anomalous_action: Reads the reflected road/sky as drivable space or oncoming traffic
rows.example: A car treats the road reflected in a truck's mirrored cargo as open lane (and may detect its own reflection as an oncoming car).

rows.ood_context: Fire engine at an active scene needing the lane
rows.anomalous_action: Stops in the path; blocks the responding engine
rows.example: SF fire crews log dozens of cases of robotaxis freezing in front of fire engines and blocking stations (SFFD incident reports).

rows.ood_context: Charged fire hose laid across the roadway
rows.anomalous_action: Drives over the deployed fire hose
rows.example: A Cruise AV runs over lengths of charged fire hose at an SF fire scene; firefighters smash a window to stop another (2022–2023).

rows.ood_context: Police caution tape and flares marking a closed scene
rows.anomalous_action: Runs through the tape toward downed wires
rows.example: Two Cruise AVs drive through caution tape into a closed scene with downed Muni wires, which snag on their roofs (Mar 2023).

rows.ood_context: Stopped bus, red lights flashing, stop-arm extended
rows.normal_action: Stop and remain stopped until the arm retracts
rows.anomalous_action: Passes the stopped bus while children load
rows.example: A Waymo stops for a stopped Austin school bus, asks remote assistance “Is this a school bus with active signals?”, is told “no,” and passes it (Jan 12, 2026; NTSB HWY26FH007; 24+ district violations).

rows.ood_context: Ambulance/police flashers and flares at a roadside incident
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to recognize the scene and drives in
rows.example: NHTSA's administrator cites “a clear pattern of driverless AVs interfering with law enforcement and other first responders” in a formal letter to AV developers.

rows.ood_context: Post-fireworks gridlock, dense crowds, degraded connectivity
rows.anomalous_action: Blocks roads, runs out of charge, must be towed
rows.example: Dozens of Waymos stall in SF's Presidio after July 4 fireworks; some run out of power and are towed (Jul 4, 2026).

rows.ood_context: Slow procession legally running a red as a group
rows.anomalous_action: Cuts into or blocks the procession
rows.example: A car cuts into a funeral procession, treating each car independently.

rows.ood_context: Runners or a parade filling a closed street
rows.normal_action: Recognize the closure; do not enter
rows.anomalous_action: Enters the closed course among people
rows.example: A car turns onto a closed marathon course crowded with runners.

rows.ood_context: Protester placing a traffic cone on the hood
rows.normal_action: Remain safe; not be trivially disabled
rows.anomalous_action: Immobilizes with hazards on until reset
rows.example: SF activists' “Week of Cone” disables Waymo/Cruise AVs by placing a single cone on the hood (Jul 2023).

rows.ood_context: Mass-casualty scene with EMS attempting a U-turn
rows.normal_action: Yield to EMS; clear the area
rows.anomalous_action: Blocks the EMS vehicle until officers move it
rows.example: A Waymo blocks an ambulance during an active-shooter response in Austin until police intervene (local reporting).

rows.ood_context: Guard holding a handheld STOP paddle
rows.anomalous_action: Ignores the paddle and proceeds
rows.example: A car ignores a crossing guard's handheld stop paddle at a school crossing.

rows.ood_context: Fallen tree/downed power line across the lane
rows.normal_action: Stop and hold before the blockage
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to perceive the thin line/limb; drives into it
rows.example: A car drives into a downed power line draped across the road.

rows.ood_context: Image of a person projected onto the road for a split second
rows.anomalous_action: Emergency-brakes for the projected “pedestrian”
rows.example: A Tesla brakes for a human figure a drone briefly projects on the pavement (phantom attacks).

rows.ood_context: Speed-limit sign projected onto a tree/wall
rows.anomalous_action: Adopts the projected speed limit
rows.example: A car changes speed for a limit sign projected onto roadside trees.

rows.ood_context: Adversarial patch making a stop sign “vanish” to the detector
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to detect the patched stop sign entirely
rows.example: Researchers hide a stop sign from object detectors with a printed adversarial patch, so the vehicle never registers it.

rows.ood_context: Three small stickers on the road forming a fake lane line
rows.anomalous_action: Follows the sticker “lane” into oncoming traffic
rows.example: Tencent Keen Lab steers a Tesla Model S toward the oncoming lane with three small road stickers mimicking merge striping.

rows.ood_context: LED sign flashing an octagon/arrow at camera height
rows.anomalous_action: Reacts to the flashed shape as a control device
rows.example: A car reacts to a programmable LED sign flashing a stop-sign shape.

rows.ood_context: Large arrow/symbol painted for a film shoot or event
rows.anomalous_action: Treats the painted arrow as a mandatory turn
rows.example: A car turns to follow a decorative arrow painted for a film shoot.

rows.ood_context: Object aimed at LiDAR to spoof phantom returns
rows.anomalous_action: Registers phantom obstacles and brakes
rows.example: A car brakes for phantom LiDAR returns created by a retroreflective decoy.

rows.ood_context: Video of a road/tunnel projected onto a surface ahead at night
rows.anomalous_action: Drives toward the projected scene
rows.example: A car heads for a tunnel entrance that is only a projection on a wall.

rows.ood_context: Billboard showing a full-screen car/brake lights at night
rows.normal_action: Recognize the screen as an ad
rows.anomalous_action: Reads the pictured car/brake lights as a lead vehicle
rows.example: A car brake-checks for brake lights shown on a nighttime video billboard.

rows.ood_context: Glass tower reflecting the street, cars, and a signal
rows.anomalous_action: Plans around reflected cars/signals as if real
rows.example: A car reacts to vehicles and a signal reflected in a mirrored building.

rows.ood_context: Traffic-light colors mirrored on a rain-slicked road
rows.anomalous_action: Reads reflected red/green on the road as a signal
rows.example: A car reads the red glow mirrored on wet asphalt as an actual red light.

rows.ood_context: LED ad truck playing video of roads/people
rows.normal_action: Recognize the screen content as media
rows.anomalous_action: Reacts to on-screen pedestrians/vehicles
rows.example: A car brakes for pedestrians appearing on a mobile billboard truck's screen.

rows.ood_context: Large puddle mirroring the sky and overhead signs
rows.anomalous_action: Reads the mirrored overhead sign as a real gantry
rows.example: A car reacts to an overhead sign reflected in a large puddle.

rows.ood_context: Ramp-closure signs and cones marking a freeway work zone
rows.normal_action: Recognize the closure; do not enter
rows.anomalous_action: Drives past closure signs into the active work zone at speed
rows.example: Waymos drive past ramp-closure signs into SR-51 freeway construction zones in Phoenix six times in April 2026; 3,800+-vehicle recall.

rows.ood_context: Crossing gate lowered, red lights flashing, train approaching
rows.normal_action: Stop and hold behind the gate
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to detect the gate/lights; drives onto the tracks
rows.example: NBC News documents 40+ reports of Tesla FSD mishandling rail crossings, including a Model 3 struck by a train in Pennsylvania; NHTSA opens a probe.

rows.ood_context: Small parking-lot roundabout/planter
rows.anomalous_action: Loops the roundabout repeatedly, unable to exit
rows.example: An unoccupied Waymo circles a small roundabout dozens of times before a software fix (Dec 2024).

rows.ood_context: Chain, gate, or thin cable strung across a driveway/road
rows.anomalous_action: Fails to perceive it; drives into the chain/gate
rows.example: Waymo logs 16 collisions with chains, gates, and barriers (2022–2024); 1,212-vehicle recall (May 2025).

rows.ood_context: Cluster of AVs repositioning in a lot overnight
rows.anomalous_action: Repeatedly honks at the other AVs through the night
rows.example: Waymos honk at each other in an SF SoMa lot at 4 a.m. for weeks, waking residents, due to an anti-collision honking feature (Aug 2024).

rows.ood_context: Double-parked car / dead-end alley with no clean exit
rows.anomalous_action: Freezes across the road, blocking traffic
rows.example: Robotaxis repeatedly freeze behind double-parked cars and block SF streets and fire stations (SFFD obstruction reports).

rows.ood_context: Automated tunnel car wash with brushes and spray
rows.normal_action: Recognize a service facility; do not auto-drive through
rows.anomalous_action: Misreads the wash tunnel/spray and behaves erratically
rows.example: A car misinterprets an automated car-wash tunnel's brushes and spray as road hazards.
